name: go-modern-guidelines
description_en: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
readme_excerpt: Modern Go Guidelines This repository contains guidelines for code agents that help them write modern Go code. For example, an agent with these guidelines uses max(a, b) instead of an if-else block, slices.Contains instead of a manual loop, cmp.Or(a, b, c) instead of a chain of nil checks. It also knows about recent additions like new(42) to get a pointer to a value and errors.AsTypeT for type-safe error matching—both from Go 1.26.
